_comment: When the Bitwarden machine-account tokens in BWS_ACCESS_TOKEN stop working.
NO SECRET IS IN THIS FILE. A BWS access token carries no expiry inside it --
expiry is a property of the machine account, held server-side and visible only
in the web vault. So the date has to be written down by whoever minted the
token, and the only alternative is discovering it when every local command
starts failing with an opaque auth error.
That is not hypothetical: mc_migrate_claude was minted 2026-09-01 with 7-day
validity, and agent/PLAN-env-to-bitwarden.md would have every local script
depend on it. Silence here becomes a scheduled outage. Since the org secrets
were deleted (7343ae9dc, 2026-09-05) it is worse than that: mc_migrate_claude
is the SOLE credential path for CI and CD, so its expiry is a total outage,
not a local inconvenience.
Update this whenever a token is minted or replaced. `warn_days` is how long
before the date the tools start shouting; it is one file-level notice period,
not a per-token lifetime.
`client_id_sha256` fingerprints the IDENTIFIER half of the token -- the
`<client-id>` of `0.<client-id>.<secret>:<key>` -- never the secret. It exists
so a token swapped without updating this file is reported, rather than the
date silently describing a machine account that no longer exists.
WHY tokens[] AND NOT ONE token. The replacement posture is a SPLIT: a
read-only account for .env and CI, and a read-write account supplied per
rotation and never stored. A single-token schema cannot describe that state,
so the file would have to be restructured at exactly the moment the operator
is minting credentials under time pressure. The array holds one entry today.
NO CI GATE READS THIS. Settled deliberately (08-driver-contract.md sec 2): an
expired token already fails loudly at every call site, and a clock-driven gate
reds the tree on a quiet day for a condition no commit caused. The one reader
is scripts/dev/bws-map-refresh.py, which warns and continues.

tokens.name: mc_migrate_claude
tokens.replacement_plan: agent/PLAN-env-to-bitwarden.md -- split into mc-ci-read (read-only, lives in .env) and mc-rotate (read-write, supplied per rotation, never stored)
